dg-APL-207099.title: Red Sea Nutrients Control Pro Multi Test Kit (NO3/PO4)
dg-APL-207099.summary: High-accuracy color-comparator tests for nitrate and phosphate, the two nutrients reef keepers track to control algae and keep corals growing and colored.
rows: Color change read against the included color disk/card
inBox: NO3 reagents A (25 ml), B (20 g), C (20 g)
PO4 reagents A (50 ml), B (15 ml)
notes: Too much nitrate or phosphate feeds nuisance algae. Too little can hold back coral growth and color. Testing regularly lets you spot the trend.

dg-APL-210926.title: Aquaforest AF Alkalinity Test Kit
dg-APL-210926.summary: A titration test kit for alkalinity (dKH) in saltwater aquariums, made for about 78–100 tests. Aquaforest suggests 7–8 dKH.

dg-APL-210925.title: Aquaforest AF Calcium Test Kit
dg-APL-210925.summary: A titration test kit for calcium in saltwater aquariums, made for about 55–65 tests. Aquaforest suggests 400–450 ppm.

dg-APL-210927.title: Aquaforest AF Magnesium Test Kit
dg-APL-210927.summary: A titration test kit for magnesium in saltwater aquariums, made for about 55–60 tests. Aquaforest suggests 1260–1500 ppm.

dg-APL-250164.title: API Reef Master Test Kit
dg-APL-250164.summary: An API reef kit that tests four key parameters: calcium, carbonate hardness (alkalinity), phosphate and nitrate.
inBox: Holding tub for easy, reusable storage
Information on how to correct unsafe water conditions
